results.title: Iran vs New Zealand Lineups, Starting 11, Bench & Formation | FWC Times
highlights:
Iran vs New Zealand lineups are yet to be confirmed for Group G Match 16 at the FIFA World Cup 2026. The IR Iran national football team and New Zealand men’s national football team meet on June 15, 2026, at Los Angeles Stadium, with kickoff at 21:00 ET. This projected lineup tracker covers the starting XI, formations, bench options, managers, and late matchday updates. This Iran national football team vs New Zealand national football team lineups tracker stays projected until official match sheets arrive.
[...]
Iran have named a 30-player preliminary squad under Amir Ghalenoei, with Mehdi Taremi and Alireza Jahanbakhsh included and Sardar Azmoun outside the current group. New Zealand have named a 26-man squad under Darren Bazeley, with Chris Wood captaining the All Whites. Official matchday lineups remain projected until both teams release their sheets.

The All Whites
[...]
Clear underdogs facing a group-stage exit — but a first-ever World Cup win is the realistic dream, and recapturing 2010’s unbeaten magic the fairy-tale ceiling.
[...]
New Zealand are the clear underdogs of Group G and will struggle against Belgium, Egypt, and Iran on paper. The most likely outcome is a group-stage exit. But the All Whites’ organization and Chris Wood’s quality make them dangerous in a one-off match, and the expanded format means a single famous result could keep their hopes flickering. A first-ever World Cup win — perhaps against Egypt or Iran — is the realistic dream. Recapturing the unbeaten spirit of 2010 would be the fairy-tale ceiling.
